description: Show the current local time, offset, work-hour band, and public holiday, if that date is one, for each city. The result includes a https://timeofmeeting.com link.

cities.description: One to eight cities. An array, or one comma-separated string. City name or a city id from search_cities. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

name: current_time_in_cities

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Current time in cities
